folds.heading: ## Historical UI-return reconciliation: suppliers, identity and proof (B247, 2026-11-04)
folds.body:
F1. Fifteen complete historical UI checkpoint/consideration reads (B247) retain the original evidence in place. R3/R11/R14–R16 explicitly released writes; their old reservations/ports are not current live processes. R12 records16 focused tests/20 journey groups with one unresolved intermittent R11 regression; R3 records inherited failures/TODOs alongside passes and a refreshed post-drift source window. R18 says committed on its branch, not merged/pushed. R21b/c/R22/R22b/c are saved-before-edit plans; later merged-base/branch references establish dated lineage, not completion of all proposed gates. AD36/AD43 keep these proof states separate and AD42 keeps human review optional.

F2. Preserve the source-fit lessons: existing native item components, item comparison, effects and clock projection should be surfaced through their actual suppliers; a Proto23 screenshot or UI callback does not establish natural progression, a new fight engine, component assembly, a perk registry or copied weather mechanics. Enemy threat, personal progression, institutional/world rank, quality/rarity and material tier are different measures. Existing renderer numbers do not make universal built-in in-world appraisal accepted. Under AD32 hover/pin/rail recommendations and source-inspired interaction choices remain scoped proposals unless separately selected by current direction.

F3. Item/skill/milestone/combat reports need the producer's actual identity and known payload at event emission. Untyped old item text is not matched retrospectively to today's bag, and later rename/seat switch cannot change an event's subject. Combat grouping retains occurrence count, actor/target and meaningful result distinctions, with accessible wording rather than color alone. Smart follow is not Freeze; collapsed history is not new durable event storage. Any source/target snapshot remains observer-qualified, and cosmetic grouping/reinspection does not replay XP, discovery or output.

F4. Native recipe uses/have/need, attempts versus guaranteed outputs, known result effects and same-station links belong to the native quote/guard and the selected task. Back restores actual selection/list scroll; inspection spends no game time or stock. Inventory category counts are native stacks independent of search, Favorites overlap is intentional, and known-empty differs from empty search. Value sorting follows displayed known value; hidden unsellable base value is not a legal sort oracle. Browser-local category/layout/seen state is different from gameplay save or once-only reward identity.

F5. Current desktop1920/Mac context, actual14/21px, prose-first independent panes and optional art qualify historical1366-first/17.5/21-only targets and old grid arrangements. Keep task/quote/blocker/commit/return and current work reachable, manual arrangement stable, and text size intact. Source-signature/init order, hidden-module routes, actual place tags and awakened panel home are distinct concrete UI seams; reducing chrome or adding a companion panel does not repair missing producer facts. Status visibility is granted by actual awakening, not by layout preference, and losing/hiding its panel is not losing the source itself. AD32 keeps scoped layout experiments as proposals rather than a permanent global five-region mandate; no new runtime or browser proof was added here.
